plan: Given my value of $14, I should aim to bid below my value to ensure a positive profit if I win. Bidding exactly $14 maximizes my potential profit while minimizing the risk of overbidding. However, since I must pay the third-highest bid if I win, I should bid slightly lower to ensure a profit margin. Bidding $13.9 allows me to potentially win while ensuring a profit if the third-highest bid is less than $13.9.

My value is $34. To maximize profit, I should bid below my value to ensure a profit if I win. Bidding $34 or higher risks breaking even or losing money. A bid slightly above half my value, around $17, balances winning chances and profit potential. This strategy avoids dominated bids, as bidding my full value or above offers no profit.

My value for the prize is $33. To maximize profit, I should bid below my value to ensure a positive payoff if I win. Bidding exactly $33 risks zero profit.
